Preserve demos as received; never use a sparse reconstruction or hand-derived expected output, since transcription errors can masquerade as rule failures. After each code edit, rerun every pair; an exception or mismatch means the program is not validated, so do not submit yet. If transcribing a grid for execution, check its row and column counts against the stated header before using its output. Before submission, check that the returned grid has 1–30 nonempty rows of equal length, with only integer cell values 0–9; output dimensions need not equal the input dimensions. from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    color = min((v for v in counts if v != background), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
    mask = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    mh, mw = max(dr for dr, dc in mask)+1, max(dc for dr, dc in mask)+1
    for top in range(h-mh+1):
        for left in range(w-mw+1):
            if all(grid[top+dr][left+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in mask):
                for dr, dc in mask:
                    out[top+dr][left+dc] = color
    return out
